RectangleCLTArxivV1.hReferencePairComple.name: RectangleCLTArxivV1.hReferencePairComplement
RectangleCLTArxivV1.hReferencePairComple.expanded_type: {r : ℕ} → RectangleCLT.Vector r → RectangleCLT.Vector r → RectangleCLT.Vector r

RectangleCLTArxivV1.hReferencePairComple.name: RectangleCLTArxivV1.hReferencePairComplement_orthogonal
RectangleCLTArxivV1.hReferencePairComple.expanded_type:
∀ {r : ℕ} (u v : RectangleCLT.Vector r),
  RectangleCLT.vectorNormSq u = 1 → RectangleCLT.faceDot u (RectangleCLTArxivV1.hReferencePairComplement u v) = 0

RectangleCLTArxivV1.hReferencePairComple.name: RectangleCLTArxivV1.hReferencePairComplement_unit
RectangleCLTArxivV1.hReferencePairComple.expanded_type:
∀ {r : ℕ} (u v : RectangleCLT.Vector r),
  RectangleCLT.vectorNormSq u = 1 →
    RectangleCLT.vectorNormSq v = 1 →
      RectangleCLT.faceDot u v ^ 2 < 1 →
        RectangleCLT.vectorNormSq (RectangleCLTArxivV1.hReferencePairComplement u v) = 1

RectangleCLTArxivV1.hReferencePairComple.name: RectangleCLTArxivV1.hReferencePairComplement_reconstruct
RectangleCLTArxivV1.hReferencePairComple.expanded_type:
∀ {r : ℕ} (u v : RectangleCLT.Vector r),
  RectangleCLT.faceDot u v ^ 2 < 1 →
    v =
      RectangleCLT.faceDot u v • u +
        √(1 - RectangleCLT.faceDot u v ^ 2) • RectangleCLTArxivV1.hReferencePairComplement u v

RectangleCLTArxivV1.hReferencePair_unit_.name: RectangleCLTArxivV1.hReferencePair_unit_coordinates_map
RectangleCLTArxivV1.hReferencePair_unit_.expanded_type:
∀ {r : ℕ} (u v : RectangleCLT.Vector r),
  RectangleCLT.vectorNormSq u = 1 →
    RectangleCLT.vectorNormSq v = 1 →
      RectangleCLT.faceDot u v ^ 2 < 1 →
        MeasureTheory.Measure.map
            (fun g =>
              (RectangleCLT.faceDot u g, RectangleCLT.faceDot (RectangleCLTArxivV1.hReferencePairComplement u v) g))
            (RectangleCLT.standardGaussian r) =
          (ProbabilityTheory.gaussianReal 0 1).prod (ProbabilityTheory.gaussianReal 0 1)

RectangleCLTArxivV1.hReferencePair_proje.name: RectangleCLTArxivV1.hReferencePair_projected_integral
RectangleCLTArxivV1.hReferencePair_proje.expanded_type:
∀ {r : ℕ} (u v : RectangleCLT.Vector r),
  RectangleCLT.vectorNormSq u = 1 →
    RectangleCLT.vectorNormSq v = 1 →
      RectangleCLT.faceDot u v ^ 2 < 1 →
        ∀ (F : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ),
          Measurable F →
            ∫ (g : RectangleCLT.Vector r),
                F (RectangleCLT.faceDot u g, RectangleCLT.faceDot v g) ∂RectangleCLT.standardGaussian r =
              ∫ (z : ℝ × ℝ),
                F
                  (z.1,
                    RectangleCLT.faceDot u v * z.1 +
                      √(1 - RectangleCLT.faceDot u v ^ 2) *
                        z.2) ∂(ProbabilityTheory.gaussianReal 0 1).prod (ProbabilityTheory.gaussianReal 0 1)

RectangleCLTArxivV1.hReferencePair_proje.name: RectangleCLTArxivV1.hReferencePair_projected_product_integral
RectangleCLTArxivV1.hReferencePair_proje.expanded_type:
∀ {Ω : Type u_1} [inst : MeasurableSpace Ω] {p r : ℕ} (μ : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω)
  [inst_1 : MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (V : Ω → RectangleCLT.Vector p),
  Measurable V →
    ∀ (u v : RectangleCLT.Vector r),
      RectangleCLT.vectorNormSq u = 1 →
        RectangleCLT.vectorNormSq v = 1 →
          RectangleCLT.faceDot u v ^ 2 < 1 →
            ∀ (f g : RectangleCLT.Face p) (h σ a b : ℝ),
              ∫ (z : Ω × RectangleCLT.Vector r),
                  RectangleCLTArxivV1.hReferencePair
                    ((RectangleCLT.FaceSmoother.normalDot f (V z.1) + σ * RectangleCLT.faceDot u z.2 - a) / h,
                      (RectangleCLT.FaceSmoother.normalDot g (V z.1) + σ * RectangleCLT.faceDot v z.2 - b) /
                        h) ∂μ.prod (RectangleCLT.standardGaussian r) =
                ∫ (z : Ω × ℝ × ℝ),
                  RectangleCLTArxivV1.hReferencePair
                    ((RectangleCLT.FaceSmoother.normalDot f (V z.1) + σ * z.2.1 - a) / h,
                      (RectangleCLT.FaceSmoother.normalDot g (V z.1) + σ * RectangleCLT.faceDot u v * z.2.1 +
                            σ * √(1 - RectangleCLT.faceDot u v ^ 2) * z.2.2 -
                          b) /
                        h) ∂μ.prod ((ProbabilityTheory.gaussianReal 0 1).prod (ProbabilityTheory.gaussianReal 0 1))

RectangleCLTArxivV1.intrinsicRectangleCo.name: RectangleCLTArxivV1.intrinsicRectangleConcentration_pair_projected_reference_mass
RectangleCLTArxivV1.intrinsicRectangleCo.expanded_type:
∀ {Ω : Type u_1} [inst : MeasurableSpace Ω] {p r : ℕ} (μ : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω)
  [inst_1 : MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (V : Ω → RectangleCLT.Vector p),
  Measurable V →
    ∀ {C₀ δ κ h σ : ℝ},
      0 ≤ C₀ →
        0 ≤ κ →
          0 < h →
            0 < σ →
              δ ≤ h →
                RectangleCLTArxivV1.IntrinsicRectangleConcentration (MeasureTheory.Measure.map V μ) C₀ δ κ →
                  ∀ (u v : RectangleCLT.Vector r),
                    RectangleCLT.vectorNormSq u = 1 →
                      RectangleCLT.vectorNormSq v = 1 →
                        RectangleCLT.faceDot u v ^ 2 < 1 →
                          ∀ (f g : RectangleCLT.Face p) (a b : ℝ),
                            ∫ (z : Ω × RectangleCLT.Vector r),
                                RectangleCLTArxivV1.hReferencePair
                                  ((RectangleCLT.FaceSmoother.normalDot f (V z.1) + σ * RectangleCLT.faceDot u z.2 -
                                        a) /
                                      h,
                                    (RectangleCLT.FaceSmoother.normalDot g (V z.1) + σ * RectangleCLT.faceDot v z.2 -
                                        b) /
                                      h) ∂μ.prod (RectangleCLT.standardGaussian r) ≤
                              2 * C₀ * h ^ 2 * κ / (σ * √(1 - RectangleCLT.faceDot u v ^ 2))

RectangleCLTArxivV1.intrinsicRectangleCo.expanded_type:
∀ {p r m : ℕ} (ν : MeasureTheory.Measure (RectangleCLT.Vector r)) [inst : MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure ν]
  (A : Matrix (Fin p) (Fin r) ℝ) {C₀ δ κ : ℝ},
  RectangleCLTArxivV1.IntrinsicRectangleConcentration (MeasureTheory.Measure.map (fun x => A.mulVec x) ν) C₀ δ κ →
    ∀ (f : Fin m → RectangleCLT.Face p) (b : RectangleCLT.Vector m) {s : ℝ},
